llm_assessment.summary: The multi-agent defense system demonstrated effectiveness in detecting hidden logical trojans, but struggled with precision and accuracy. The PAIR attack system generated high-quality trojans, but the defense's weaknesses were evident in its high false positive rate and low accuracy.
